comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
As you noted, these outfits are not color-customizable. To gain the common colored versions, you must buy them from the Stockholm Item Shop. (Easiest; limited to two colors, one per gender.)

If you wish to own the variant colors, however, you (or somebody you trust) must use a R10 Sewing recipe found in Stockholm with an NPC (Resident? sorry, can't recall the exact name offhand); this method requires cotton fabric x15, feather x15, embroidery thread x20.

Hope that helps.
